summary: Greenwave Technology Solutions filed an 8-K on September 7, 2026, disclosing a private placement of 3,750 shares of Series B Convertible Preferred Stock to five institutional investors at a $1,000 stated value, raising approximately $3.75 million in gross proceeds, before fees. The preferred stock is initially convertible at $5.24 per share into roughly 715,649 common shares, with closing expected on September 9, 2026. Proceeds will fund working capital. The placement was exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D. Watch for conversion-driven dilution and any preferred-overhang pressure on GWAV common stock.
